name: password-checklist
title: Password checklist
description: Live password rule checklist with a reusable isStrongPassword predicate. Labels come from the host; the rules mirror the newbie account module's password policy (validator.isStrongPassword defaults: 8+ chars, lower/upper/number/symbol) and must be updated manually when the backend policy changes.
postInstall: Render <PasswordChecklist labels={...} password={...}> under password inputs (pairs with the login-form item in sign-up/change-password screens). The host supplies translated labels; the rules array is a manual mirror of the newbie account password policy, so sync it here when the backend strategy changes.
